summary: Full regression of BRUNO monetization layer (Stripe TEST mode). Backend tests: /app/backend/tests/test_money.py → 24/24 PASS. Frontend: /earnings renders with data-connected='0', balances, country select (Colombia blocked toast, MX connect_not_enabled toast), CSV downloads starting with 'fecha,tipo', empty rows copy OK. /admin/money for testc shows fees 10/15/5, edit gift→16 saves, toast 'Comisiones actualizadas', reload persists 16, reverted to 15 OK; USD summary with 'Comisiones netas BRUNO' and 'terceros' copy; ledger shows 3 promotion entries. /admin/money for testa shows admin-money-forbidden. Marketplace: non-DEAL product shows product-pay-in-bruno-btn → checkout-quote with 5% split text; DEAL products DO NOT render the pay-in-bruno button (only deal-purchase-btn 'Comprar'). Live gift flow (public live by B): rose quote 0,99 US$ with 15% split and 'Enviar regalo' CTA. /payment/success invalid session → data-status=checking → timeout after ~30s. /payment/cancel shows 'Pago cancelado'. /payment/success without kind renders Premium page. API isolation OK (A earnings empty, B purchases empty). Backend regression + 24/24.

ui_bugs.issue: For a private + paid live (is_private:true + ticket_price:5), opening /lives/{id} as a non-ticketed viewer shows the ACCESS CODE gate ('Live privado · Ingresa el código') instead of live-ticket-gate with checkout-quote. The join() is only auto-triggered when !requires_code || code.length===6, so the 402 ticket_required path never fires. Spec requires ticket gate to appear instead (or alongside) the code gate.

On DEAL-enabled products (deal_enabled:true) the product-pay-in-bruno-btn is NOT rendered — only the deal-purchase-btn 'Comprar'. Spec says Pagar en BRUNO should be available on any product not owned by the viewer. Non-DEAL products render it correctly.

After clicking quote-pay-btn on a non-DEAL marketplace product, there was no visible navigation to Stripe and no seller_not_ready toast captured in the DOM. URL stayed on /marketplace/{id}. Possibly a silent error — needs verification.

issues: QuoteCard renders inline above the fixed action bar (y=526, h=218). No overlap observed because the fixed bar sits below card. --content-bottom reserve appears respected.

action_items: LiveViewerPage: when live.ticket_price > 0, call join() or probe getQuote({kind:'live_ticket'}) at mount even if requires_code is true, so the ticket gate is shown instead of (or in addition to) the code gate; or branch UI on live.ticket_price before the code gate.
ProductDetailPage: render product-pay-in-bruno-btn also for DEAL-enabled products (independent of DEAL vs non-DEAL flows), or document why DEAL excludes it.

Investigate why non-DEAL quote-pay-btn click didn't yield a toast or redirect — probably backend returned seller_not_ready (409) and toast was not surfaced; verify brunoToast.error path in useBrunoCheckout.
critical_code_review_comments: LiveViewerPage ticket detection only runs through join() error path; needs proactive handling for private+paid lives.
DEAL/non-DEAL branching in ProductDetailPage hides new monetization CTA for DEAL products.

Remaining items: (1) private+paid live gate flow needs the live-ticket-gate to render pre-code; (2) DEAL products missing product-pay-in-bruno-btn; (3) non-DEAL marketplace pay button error pathway (seller_not_ready) didn't surface — verify toast after fix.
rca of the issue: LiveViewerPage.jsx: effect auto-calls join() only when !live.requires_code or 6-digit code entered. On a private paid live (requires_code=true + ticket_price>0), join() is never triggered without a code, so the 402 ticket_required branch that would set ticket state and fetch the quote never fires → user sees code gate instead of ticket gate.
